Full description

Overview Since our founding in 1924, we've cut cardiovascular disease deaths in half, but there is still so much more to do. To overcome today’s biggest health challenges and accelerate this progress, we need passionate individuals like you. Join our movement, be part of the progress, and help ensure a healthier future for all. You matter, and so does the impact you can make with us. The American Heart Association has an exciting opportunity for a Marketing Communications Director serving the Nevada and Southern Arizona Division teams. This hybrid role may be based in Las Vegas, NV, or Tucson, AZ, with work taking place across home office, community, and office settings to support marketing, communications, and mission-driven initiatives. The Marketing Communications Director develops and implements strategic communications, marketing, media relations, and public relations initiatives for the American Heart Association across the Nevada and Southern, while providing communications support for other territories as needed. This role advances the American Heart Association’s position as the leading authority on cardiovascular health and science through integrated external and internal communications, marketing campaigns, media outreach, digital strategies, sponsorship activation, and special initiatives. The Association offers many resources to help you maintain work-life harmonization through your changing needs and life situations. To help you be successful, you will have access to Heart U, our award-winning corporate university, as well as additional training and support, locally. #TheAHALife is more than a company culture; it is our way of life. It embodies our commitment to work-life harmonization and is guided by our core values where our employees can thrive both personally and professionally. Discover why you will Be Seen. Be Heard. Be Valued at the American Heart Association by following us on LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, and at heart.jobs. Responsibilities Brand Integrity Maintains the integrity of the brand and identity of the American Heart Association by developing and/or reviewing/editing communications and marketing materials. Traditional and Digital Media Raise visibility of the Division via traditional and digital media outlets. Maintain and steward existing media relationships. Explore and engage new outlets, especially media with reach to targeted audiences. Research and monitor new/burgeoning media, especially those being developed in the Las Vegas and Tucson markets. Seeks, cultivates, and maintains regional media relationships, with traditional and emerging media. Secures formal media partnerships/sponsorships for various events, campaigns and cause initiatives as appropriate. Pitches “big picture” stories, focusing on hard news, feature and research stories, to Las Vegas and Tucson markets. Researches and prepares media and background materials to support American Heart Association policy issues and community programs. Develops fast response mechanism for hard news stories. Alerts field staff with media advisories and cause/marketing activities as appropriate. Overall Campaign Development and Traction Work closely with internal partners to be an innovator and market disruptor. Seek new approaches to transforming sponsorship communications and marketing deliverables. Steward current sponsorships and expand into new industries. Help craft mission-focused proposals and weave in media, marketing and messaging themes to fully complement our campaigns. Contribute to campaign revenue through health asset sponsorships/activations. Develops and submits proposals outlining the details of the partnerships/sponsorships. Supports day-of event activities. Elevate Visibility of Local Divisions as Engaged Community Stakeholders To truly make an impact, each market needs to be widely recognized as a trusted and reliable stakeholder. We are invested in the overall health of the communities we serve. Implements communications plans with media advocacy, public policy initiatives and media spokespeople. Contributes to volunteer leadership, including helping identify and recruit potential committee and board members. Identifies, recruits and trains volunteers who can serve as media and cause initiative spokespersons. Maintains an accessible database of human interest stories to tap for media inquiries. Develops and executes social media strategy in conjunction with digital staff. Works with internal and external partners to produce mission-focused content for organic social channels. Plans and executes paid social media campaigns. Develops, in conjunction with field staff and volunteers, and oversees implementation of communications and marketing plans. Works with internal partners to ensure effective local implementation of field-related communications and marketing activities. Works with external media partners to plan and execute advertising campaigns. Serves as communications and marketing consultant to staff and volunteers, including conducting communications orientation and training, monitoring progress on key objectives and cause initiatives, and providing general counsel and guidance. Coordinates, in conjunction with National Center and Western States communications and marketing staff, communications- and marketing-related promotions, mailings, distribution, and reporting. Qualifications 3 years minimum prior related experience with: Knowledge of variety of mass and alternative media, and principles of journalism including news gathering, interviewing, writing and editing. Basic video, graphic design and photography skills desired. Experience in communications, marketing, or public affairs with a background in journalism, public relations, marketing, advertising or similar position. Knowledge and experience with the fundamentals of multiple disciplines are needed, including the principles and ethics of public relations, promotion, marketing and business communications. Demonstrated excellence in written communications skills, including news, business, and persuasive writing. Demonstrated skills in effective one-on-one and group communications and work with all levels of media contacts, community leaders, and American Heart Association volunteers and staff. Ability to deal professionally in a corporate and non-profit environment and assume responsibility for guiding communications and marketing projects and programs from inception through completion. Demonstrated ability to simultaneously manage multiple, complex projects in varying stages of development under time pressure. Knowledge and experience with developing content for event collateral materials. University/College degree or equivalent experience. Here are some of the preferred skills we are looking for: Knowledge of the principles and practices of strategic planning, budgeting, and managing work. Knowledge of basic fund-raising principles, practices, and techniques. Knowledge of American Heart Association’s mission and programs. Compensation & Benefits Expected pay range will be $64,575 to $86,205 annually. Pay is commensurate with experience; geographic differentials to the pay range may apply. The American Heart Association reserves the right to pay more or less than the posted range. The American Heart Association invests in its people. Here are the main components of our total rewards package. Visit Rewards & Benefits to see more details. Compensation – Our goal is to ensure you have a competitive base salary. That’s why we regularly review the market value of jobs and make adjustments, as needed. Performance and Recognition – You are rewarded for achieving success through annual salary planning and incentive programs; eligibility for an incentive program is based on the type of position. Benefits – We offer a wide array of benefits including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance, along with a robust retirement program that includes an employer match and automatic contribution. As a mark of our commitment to employee well-being, we also offer an employee assistance program, employee wellness program and telemedicine, and medical consultation. Professional Development – You can join one of our many Employee Resource Groups (ERG) or be a mentor/mentee in our professional mentoring program. Heart U is the Association’s national online university, with more than 100,000 resources designed to meet your needs and busy schedule. Work-Life Harmonization – The Association offers Paid Time Off (PTO) at a minimum of 16 days per year for new employees. The number of days will increase based on seniority level. You will also have a total of 12 paid holidays off each year, which includes several days off at the end of the year. Tuition Assistance - We support the career development of all employees. This program provides financial assistance to employees who wish to further their education and career in relation to their current duties and responsibilities, or for potential future positions in the organization. The American Heart Association’s 2028 Goal: Building on over 100 years of trusted leadership in cardiovascular and brain health, by 2028 the Association will drive breakthroughs and implement proven solutions in science, policy, and care for healthier people and communities. The greatest discoveries in health must reach everyone where they are. At American Heart Association | American Stroke Association, our mission is to be a relentless force for a world of longer, healthier lives, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, gender identity, religion, age, language, sexual orientation, national origin and physical or cognitive abilities. The Marketing Generalist collaborates with internal partners across the organization to help develop relevant and engaging communications for the communities that CFB serves. Duties and Responsibilities: Creates and supports marketing and communications content across digital, print, social media, web, email, multimedia, and other channels. Conducts interviews with clients, donors, volunteers, staff, community partners, and members of the public to identify and develop compelling stories that advance the Community Food Bank’s mission. Writes, edits, and proofreads content for internal and external communications, in alignment with organizational messaging and brand standards. Helps create and maintain engaging digital content across the organization’s website, social media platforms, email communications, and other web-based channels. Supports the development and execution of integrated marketing and communications campaigns using traditional and digital channels, including multilingual communications as needed. Coordinates advertising activities with media outlets and vendors, including newspapers, websites, television, radio, social media, and other digital platforms. Researches advertising opportunities, marketing channels, tools, and emerging trends and shares findings with Marketing leadership. Coordinates print production with designated vendors, including requesting quotes, submitting print-ready files, tracking orders, and ensuring timely delivery. Processes marketing vendor invoices, secures appropriate approvals, maintains expense records, and tracks translation-related expenses and budgets. Creates and adapts graphics and visual assets for print and digital communications using Adobe Creative Suite and established brand guidelines and templates. Supports video production, editing, motion graphics, photography, and other multimedia projects. Maintains and organizes the organization’s photo and digital asset library, ensuring current and relevant visual content is available for marketing and communications needs. Supports website content management, including creating, editing, and updating content within the organization’s CMS. Monitors and analyzes website, social media, advertising, and other marketing performance data and helps prepare reports using tools such as Google Analytics. Provides marketing and communications support for grant reporting requirements, working closely with the Grants team to ensure required social media, advertising, and traditional media activities are completed and documented. Stays current on marketing, communications, digital, social media, design, and industry trends and identifies opportunities to incorporate new tools, platforms, and approaches into the organization’s work. Performs other duties as assigned. Knowledge, Skills and Abilities: Knowledge of integrated marketing principles and practices, including content marketing, social media, digital marketing, advertising, and media planning. Knowledge of digital communications and web-based environments, including content management systems, social media platforms, email marketing, and blogging platforms. Proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite and experience creating graphics and other visual content for both print and digital applications. Strong writing, editing, proofreading, and storytelling skills, with the ability to write effectively for a variety of audiences and channels. Experience with website analytics and reporting tools, such as Google Analytics. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, vendors, and priorities simultaneously. Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, take initiative, and move projects forward with minimal direction. Ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues, vendors, community partners, and individuals across diverse departments and areas of expertise. Adaptability and willingness to learn new technologies, platforms, tools, and marketing practices. Demonstrated curiosity and commitment to professional growth and incorporating new information into day-to-day work. Ability to communicate and work effectively with people from diverse economic, social, cultural, and political backgrounds Minimum Qualifications: A high school diploma or equivalent. Three (3) years of experience in Marketing, Advertising or Communications. Proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite, Microsoft Office Suite, Office 365, and aptitude to learn other software platforms. For company insurance purposes, at least 21 years of age; possess a current Arizona Driver’s License with a safe driving record. Equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered if applicable and must be directly related to the functions and body of knowledge required to successfully perform the job. Preferred Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Graphic Design, or a related field. Bilingual in English and Spanish. Physical Requirements: Light Work – ability to exert 20 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 10 pounds of force frequently, and/or a negligible amount of force constantly to move objects. Knowledge, Skills and Abilities: Knowledge of utilizing experiential, content, and social media marketing campaigns and working with media plans. Knowledge of web-based environments (such as CMS, Twitter, Facebook, and blogging software) working in CMS platforms to maintain and create digital content. Skills in MS Office and adept with Adobe Creative Suite for both print and digital application. Skills in creating and preparing reports in Google Analytics. Ability to write according to the Associated Press Stylebook guidelines. Ability to work without a high-level of direction. Self-motivator and takes initiative. Life-long learner and ability to incorporate new information. Demonstrated interest in learning internally and externally and incorporating new information into role. Ability to work with people from diverse economic, social, and political backgrounds. Minimum Qualifications: A high school diploma or equivalent. Two (2) years of experience in Marketing, Advertising or Communications. Proficiency with Adobe Creative Suites. For company insurance purposes, at least 21 years of age; possess a current Arizona Driver’s License with a safe driving record. The role will be responsible for coordinating program logistics, managing project plans and timelines, partnering with internal and external vendors, and ensuring seamless execution of client experiences. This role is part of our hybrid work model with a required three days a week onsite (Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday) in the following locations: Malvern PA; Charlotte, NC; Dallas (Plano), TX; Scottsdale, AZ. Fully remote work is not available for this role. Special Factors Sponsorship Vanguard is not offering visa sponsorship for this position. To lead through product and services that transform our clients' lives. To learn and develop our skills as individuals and as a team. Develops and executes the annual service line strategic marketing plan(s), with distinct focus on patient acquisition and retention, utilizing financial, operational and market share data and analytics to prioritize efforts and to develop goals, strategies and KPIs. II. Maintains accountability for overall quality of marketing strategy, plans and execution. III. Manages all service line digital content (including online physician bios) and social media content, including blogs. IV. Crafts and manages timely contribution and distribution of social media campaign content (paid and unpaid) in coordination with overarching campaign goals and strategies. IV. Oversees operational readiness before the launch of any ad/marketing campaign to ensure a seamless patient journey. Working under the direction of the Director of Marketing, this professional continually analyzes and monitors industry and service line trends. Branding I. Serves as the marketing project manager of Phoenix Children’s rebranding initiatives, including the day-to-day contact with the branding agency of record. Sports Partnerships I. Is responsible for tracking and measuring all campaigns/activities; provides quarterly reports to service line operational leaders, physicians and other key stakeholders. DIGITAL MARKETING & COMMUNICATIONS SPECIALIST Job Location: Address: 1400 West Washington Street, Phoenix, Arizona 85007 Posting Details: Salary: $82,000.00 - $88,000.00 Annually Grade: 23 Closing Date: October 10, 2026 Job Summary: The Digital Marketing & Communications Specialist (Administrative Project Manager 2) will report to the agency deputy director and be responsible for supporting strategic communication, marketing and public relations in support of the Office of Economic Opportunity’s programs and initiatives. This position will translate complex economic data, policy initiatives, and strategic objectives into clear, engaging, and accessible narratives for a diverse range of stakeholders, including businesses, policymakers, and the all Arizonans. This role is responsible for end-to-end digital content creation, multi-channel distribution, email marketing, social media management, and the development of high-impact executive presentations that align with the Director’s priorities and the agency's 5-year strategic vision. This position may offer the ability to work remotely, within Arizona, based upon the department's business needs and continual meeting of expected performance measures. The State of Arizona strives for a work culture that affords employees flexibility, autonomy, and trust. Across our many agencies, boards, and commissions, many State employees participate in the State’s Remote Work Program and are able to work remotely in their homes, in offices, and in hoteling spaces. All work, including remote work, should be performed within Arizona unless an exception is properly authorized in advance. Job Duties: • Manages agency multi-Channel Content Creation & Distribution: Drafts, designs, edits, and schedules high-volume external digital content, including weekly/monthly email newsletters, pass advisories, media releases, and educational materials supporting OEO programs; ensures all digital assets, documents, and multimedia content strictly adhere to federal and state accessibility standards (including Section 508 compliance and WCAG guidelines); and maintains rigid alignment with official State of Arizona and OEO branding guidelines across all public-facing materials. This includes working with and assisting with supervising contracted vendors including marketing and public relations firms. • Executive Narrative & Visual Storytelling: Translates complex workforce development strategy, labor market information, economic policy data, and statewide strategic objectives into highly polished, high-impact PowerPoint or other types of presentations to external audiences; serves as the lead architect and custodian for all agency slide decks, ensuring visual and branding consistency and narrative clarity; and collaborates closely with agency leadership to ensure all presentation content directly reflects the agency leadership priorities, official brand standards, and the agency's 5-year strategic vision. • Email Marketing & List Management: Manages the agency's enterprise email distribution and marketing platforms (e.g. SendGrid); oversees subscriber list health, execution of data hygiene practices, and strategic audience segmentation to maximize engagement and ensure targeted delivery of all agency external communications; and monitors and analyzes email metrics (open rates, CTRs, bounce rates) to continuously optimize campaign effectiveness. • Social Media Management & Digital Monitoring: Maintains and executes the agency's daily active presence across primary social media platforms including X, LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram; develops and maintains a comprehensive digital content calendar to ensure a steady stream of information regarding Arizona's economic growth; monitors digital channels for public inquiries, industry trends, and media mentions, escalating sensitive issues to leadership as appropriate; and interacts with key stakeholders and responds to incoming messages on a timely basis across agency contact inbox and social media direct messages • Other duties as assigned as related to the position including: Supports OEO webinars, town halls, press conferences, or public events across the state; and participates in cross-agency communications workgroups within the State of Arizona enterprise. Knowledge, Skills & Abilities (KSAs): Knowledge of: • Principles, theories, and practices of public relations, digital marketing, and strategic communications within a government or public sector environment; • Digital accessibility laws, specifically Section 508 compliance and Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG 2.1 Level AA standards); • Graphic design principles, visual storytelling techniques, and data visualization • Email marketing best practices, list management, and platform logistics (e.g., SendGrid); • Current trends, algorithms, and best practices for professional social media platforms (LinkedIn, X, Facebook, Instagram). Skills in: • Advanced Microsoft PowerPoint design, including template creation, data integration, and narrative structuring for executive audiences; • Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to translate dense economic data into plain language; • Basic graphic design tools (e.g., Canva) and content management systems; • Audience segmentation and data analytics for email and social media campaigns; • Project management, multitasking, and meeting tight deadlines in a fast-paced environment. Ability to: • Effectively synthesize complex policy objectives into cohesive, visually compelling presentations; • Maintain absolute confidentiality and exercise impeccable judgment when handling sensitive economic data or executive messaging; • Establish and maintain effective working relationships across all levels of the agency, including executive leadership and external stakeholders; • Adapt quickly to shifting priorities, breaking news, or changing directive mandates from the Director’s office. Selective Preference(s): • A Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Public Relations, Marketing, Graphic Design, Business Administration, or a closely related field. • Experience managing communications or public information for a state, local, or federal government agency. • Demonstrated experience creating data-heavy executive presentations (PowerPoint portfolios may be requested). • Technical proficiency with SendGrid or comparable enterprise email marketing systems. Certified knowledge of Section 508/accessible design. Pre-Employment Requirements: • Two (2) years of professional experience in digital content creation, public relations, or marketing. • Professional experience in professional communications roles may substitute for the required degree on a year-for-year basis. If this position requires driving or the use of a vehicle as an essential function of the job to conduct State business, then the following requirements apply: Driver’s License Requirements. All newly hired State employees are subject to and must successfully complete the Electronic Employment Eligibility Verification Program (E-Verify). Benefits: The State of Arizona offers a comprehensive benefits package to include: • Sick leave • Vacation with 10 paid holidays per year • Paid Parental Leave-Up to 12 weeks per year paid leave for newborn or newly-placed foster/adopted child (pilot program) • Health and dental insurance • Retirement plan • Life insurance and long-term disability insurance • Optional employee benefits include short-term disability insurance, deferred compensation plans, and supplemental life insurance By providing the option of a full-time or part-time remote work schedule, employees enjoy improved work/life balance, report higher job satisfaction, and are more productive. Remote work is a management option and not an employee entitlement or right. An agency may terminate a remote work agreement at its discretion. Learn more about the Paid Parental Leave program here. For a complete list of benefits provided by The State of Arizona, please visit our benefits page Retirement: • Positions in this classification participate in the Arizona State Retirement System (ASRS) • Please note, enrollment eligibility will become effective after 27 weeks of employment Contact Us: If you have any questions please feel free to contact Rose Ibe at rose.ibe@azdoa.gov.

Description SAIC is seeking a creative, organized and experienced Internal Communications Principal to lead the day-to-day delivery of HR communications. This role is ideal for a strong writer and hands-on communicator who can turn complex information into clear, engaging content and manage projects from planning through publication. This position can be worked remotely anywhere in the United States for the right candidate. Candidates must be U.S. Citizens. Reporting to the Internal Communications strategic lead for HR, you will translate communications strategy into coordinated campaigns that help employees understand their benefits, develop their careers, navigate change and connect with SAIC. You will partner closely with HR teams and Corporate Communications to manage content, deadlines, approvals and publishing across employee channels. Key Responsibilities Execute integrated, multi-channel HR communications plans aligned with the strategy and messaging established by the HR communications lead. Manage communications delivery for benefits, performance management, talent development, employee surveys, employee communities and other HR initiatives. Write and edit employee emails, intranet stories, FAQs, leader toolkits, talking points, presentations and other communications in SAIC’s HR voice. Translate complex HR information into concise, accurate messaging that explains what employees need to know and what action to take. Maintain the integrated HR editorial calendar, coordinate timelines and identify opportunities to combine messages, reduce duplication and avoid competing deadlines. Manage incoming communications requests, clarify objectives and audiences, and recommend channels using established guidelines. Support a more coordinated employee experience by using targeted email, SAICGo, manager cascades and evergreen intranet content appropriately. Own the upload, formatting and publication of HR stories in SAICGo, including images, links, tags, scheduling, accessibility and final checks of published content. Coordinate featured placement and digest inclusion with channel owners. Manage stakeholder reviews and approvals, confirm information with HR subject-matter experts and keep projects moving through publication. Prepare drafts of executive and leader communications under the direction of the HR communications lead. Monitor communications performance and employee feedback, and recommend improvements to content, timing and channel use. Flag sensitive issues, competing priorities and decisions requiring strategic guidance. Learn and use communications and marketing platforms, including FirstUp and MarketScale, to publish content, deliver targeted communications and review campaign performance. Analyze email performance metrics, including delivery, opens, clicks and audience engagement, to identify opportunities to improve subject lines, content, calls to action, targeting, timing and frequency. Translate performance data into practical recommendations and test improvements in future communications. What We’re Looking For Demonstrated experience delivering employee communications and managing multiple campaigns in a complex organization. Exceptional writing, editing and storytelling skills, with the ability to make technical or policy-heavy information clear, conversational and actionable. Strong project management and organizational skills, including ownership of calendars, deadlines, review processes and deliverables. Sound editorial judgment and an understanding of how audience, purpose and urgency should guide channel selection. Hands-on experience publishing content through an intranet, employee communications platform or content management system. Exceptional attention to detail, including accuracy, formatting, links, accessibility and consistency. Strong collaboration and relationship-building skills, with the confidence to ask questions, recommend alternatives and manage stakeholder expectations. Ability to work independently, anticipate needs and exercise judgment about when to involve the strategic lead. Experience communicating with a distributed workforce, including employees working at customer sites. Comfort using engagement data and employee feedback to improve communications. A creative mindset and a practical approach to solving problems and improving workflows. Comfort learning new communications and marketing tools, including FirstUp and MarketScale, and applying them to day-to-day campaign delivery. Ability to interpret email and campaign metrics, identify patterns and recommend changes that improve employee engagement and action. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in communications, Public Relations, Marketing or a related field, and 10 years of experience. Master’s degree and 8 years of experience. Candidates must be U.S. Citizens Seven or more years of relevant communications experience.Candidates must have a strong command of AP Style.Experience managing communications projects from planning through publication.Proficiency with digital publishing tools and Microsoft Office applications.HR or change communications experience preferred.Experience using digital communications or marketing platforms and reviewing campaign performance; familiarity with FirstUp or MarketScale preferred. Target salary range: $100,001 - $140,000. The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience and other factors.

Full description

Job Description It’s extremely important that Army National Guard communications don’t fall into the wrong hands. As the Radio and Communications Security Repairer, you will maintain the equipment and systems that ensure Army National Guard units can communicate over secure channels. Your duties will include installing and repairing circuits and wiring, calibrating and aligning equipment components, and stringing overhead cables between utility poles. Other duties include repairing systems, performing equipment tests, and performing preventive maintenance checks and services on equipment. Advanced Radio and Communications Security Repairers take on more challenging projects, including training and supervising other Soldiers, testing equipment, performing complex repairs, and ensuring that the National Security Agency-approved components are used in communication security/controlled cryptographic item repairs. Job Duties Use test, measurement, and diagnostic equipment; test program sets and interactive electronic technical manuals to troubleshoot and repair equipment Some Of The Skills You’ll Learn Communication security policy and procedure Helpful Skills Strong attention to detail Through your training, you will develop the skills and experience to enjoy a civilian career in radio repair, radio mechanics, teletype repair, or station installation. Earn While You Learn Instead of paying to learn these skills, get paid to train. In the Army National Guard, you will learn these valuable job skills while earning a regular paycheck and qualifying for tuition assistance. After 10 weeks of Basic Training, where you will learn fundamental Soldiering skills, you will attend Advanced Individual Training (AIT) for 16 weeks of classroom instruction, including practice with equipment. You will learn mechanical, electronic, and electrical principles, preventive maintenance procedures, and communication security policies and procedures. Benefits/Requirements Benefits Paid trainingA monthly paycheckMontgomery GI BillFederal and State tuition assistanceRetirement benefits for part-time serviceLow-cost life insurance (up to $400,000 in coverage)401(k)-type savings planStudent Loan Repayment Program (up to $50,000, for existing loans)Health care benefits availableVA home loansBonuses, if applicableMost non-prior service candidates will earn between $200 and $250 per drill weekend, subject to change Requirements Military enlistment in the Army National GuardMust be at least a junior in high school, or have a high school diploma or a GED certificateMust be between the ages of 17 and 35Must be able to pass a physical exam and meet legal and moral standardsMust meet citizenship requirements (see NATIONALGUARD.com for details) Requires military enlistment. Full description

Mister Car Wash is rewriting the rules of the car wash industry. Headquartered in Tucson, Arizona, we are the nation's largest and fastest growing multibillion dollar car wash company with over 500 car washes in 21 states! We wash cars for the fun of it. We put people first. We help turn jobs into careers. We're currently seeking a Head of Growth Marketing to join our Headquarters team! The Head of Growth Marketing is responsible for accelerating profitable customer acquisition, retention, and lifetime value across a national footprint of car wash locations. This leader will own a full funnel paid media strategy, agency management, performance analytics, and cross-functional storytelling that connects marketing investment to incremental trips, sales, and membership growth. The ideal candidate has a proven track record of driving sustainable growth through data-backed paid media investment, while understanding the importance of brand and power of creative to drive efficiency. They thrive in a fast-paced environment and have experience with subscription or membership-based businesses with a nationwide retail footprint. What You Will Do: Media Strategy & Execution: Own the brand's full funnel media strategy, including channel mix, budget allocation, pacing, and creative/messaging frameworks. Manage the media agency, including daily KPI, campaign, and budget oversight to ensure the highest level of agency execution and spend efficiency. Oversee daily and weekly optimizations and budget allocation across all channels (paid social, search, video, display, OOH, audio, direct mail, and emerging platforms). Drive an optimized mix of single retail washes and membership conversions, ensuring media supports both short-term revenue and long-term customer value. Partner with internal and external creative teams to ensure that paid creative is both brand-aligned and performance optimized to drive a compelling and differentiated Mister story across channels. Performance Measurement & Analytics: Build and maintain daily, weekly, and monthly reporting dashboards that clearly communicate performance vs goals, and indicate recommended actions. Analyze channel-level and campaign-level performance to identify opportunities to improve ROAS, CAC, CPP, and Comp Store Sales growth. Prove the financial impact of media investment by measuring incremental trips, incremental revenue, and membership growth. Collaborate with Finance and Data Science to refine marketing measurement, including attribution models, incrementality testing, and forecasting. Consumer & Digital Experience Insights: Map user journeys across paid media channels and digital properties (website, app, search, maps, organic social) to identify friction points and partner with Product, Operations, and CX to improve conversion and retention. Leverage first-party data, CRM insights, and membership behavior to inform targeting, segmentation, and personalization strategies. Executive Communication & Cross-Functional Leadership: Prepare and deliver executive level presentations that translate complex performance data into clear narratives and business recommendations. Partner closely with Operations, Finance, Creative, and Technology teams to ensure marketing strategies align with business priorities. Serve as a thought leader on growth marketing best practices, testing frameworks, and emerging media opportunities. Note: The job duties above provide a general sense of the role; though, additional duties may be assigned as necessary. How You Will Shine: Education: Bachelor's degree preferred. Ongoing professional development in growth marketing, performance media, analytics, or digital strategy is strongly encouraged. Experience: 7-10+ years in growth marketing, performance marketing, or media strategy roles. Experience scaling subscription or membership models (e.g., fitness, automotive services, retail clubs, telecom). Deep understanding of regional media planning and multimarket execution. Expertise in full funnel media channels, including paid search, paid social, programmatic, video/CTV, audio, OOH, and direct response tactics. Strong command of performance metrics, including ROAS, CAC, CPP, LTV, Comp Store Sales, and incrementality measurement/testing. Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities: 7-10+ years in growth marketing, performance marketing, or media strategy roles. Experience scaling subscription or membership models (e.g., fitness, automotive services, retail clubs, telecom). Deep understanding of regional media planning and multimarket execution. Expertise in full funnel media channels, including paid search, paid social, programmatic, video/CTV, audio, OOH, and direct response tactics. Strong command of performance metrics, including ROAS, CAC, CPP, LTV, Comp Store Sales, and incrementality measurement/testing audiences. What motivates our team: Excellent Benefits including medical, vision, dental, PTO, 401k, etc. Career Progression with a high growth. Modern office space in the heart of downtown Tucson. On-site Fitness Gym and Bike Share. Employee Game Room and Lounge. Free Unlimited Wash Club Membership. It's your time to SHINE! Join the Mister Car Wash team today! Full description

Hexagon’s Mining division is seeking a Content Marketing Strategist to help shape and create compelling content for audiences around the world. This is a hands-on content role for a marketer and storyteller who understands how to turn complex ideas, customer challenges, and technology into clear, engaging narratives. Working across written, video, digital, and social channels, you will help develop content that supports Hexagon’s business priorities, strengthens our brand, and connects with customers. Video will be an important part of the role, from identifying and developing stories to scripting, shooting, editing, and distribution. But it is one tool in a broader content mix. We are looking for someone who thinks first about the audience, the story, and the business objective, then determines the best way to bring that story to life. You will work with colleagues, customers, and partners around the world and will have considerable autonomy to identify content opportunities, develop ideas, and manage projects from concept through delivery. Job responsibilities Support the development and execution of content strategies aligned with marketing, communications, product, campaign, and business priorities.Identify strong stories and translate complex technical and business subjects into clear, audience-focused content.Develop content across multiple formats and channels, including video, customer stories, articles, campaign content, product marketing materials, social media, and digital platforms.Lead video projects from concept to delivery, including research, story development, scripting and storyboarding, filming, editing, distribution, and measurement.Work directly with customers, subject-matter experts, product managers, sales teams, executives, and marketing colleagues to uncover insights and develop credible, relevant stories.Apply strong copywriting and editorial judgement to ensure content is concise, engaging, accurate, and appropriate for its intended audience.Ensure content aligns with Hexagon's brand identity, messaging, product positioning, and tone of voice.Identify opportunities to repurpose, adapt, and optimise existing content across channels and audiences, prioritising quality and relevance over volume.Use content and campaign performance data to understand audience engagement, assess effectiveness, and recommend improvements.Manage multiple content projects simultaneously, from initial brief through stakeholder review, production, publication, and measurement.Manage external agencies, freelancers, and production partners when specialist skills or additional capacity are required.Contribute ideas and recommendations that help evolve Hexagon Mining's content and video strategy.Knowledge and Experience - Required: 5+ years of professional experience in content marketing, communications, brand marketing, journalism, or a related field, preferably within a B2B, technology, industrial, engineering, or similarly complex environment.A Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, journalism, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.Strong storytelling and copywriting skills, with the ability to find the human and business story within complex or technical subject matter.Experience working in mining, technology, industrial, engineering, or another complex B2B environment.Demonstrated experience developing content as part of broader campaigns, product launches, customer marketing, or communications programmes.Practical video production experience, including storyboarding, scripting, filming, and editing.Proficiency with Adobe Premiere Pro or comparable professional editing software, with the ability to adapt to Premiere Pro.Knowledge and Experience - Desired: Experience creating content in collaboration with customers and turning customer experiences into compelling stories.Experience managing agencies, freelancers, or production vendors across different markets.Experience with Adobe Creative Cloud beyond Premiere Pro, including tools such as After Effects, Photoshop, or Audition.Photography and on-location video production experience.Experience using marketing and customer data to understand customer behaviour, identify audience or content insights, and inform content strategy and decision-making.Experience analysing content performance and translating data into practical recommendations for future content and campaigns.Spanish or Portuguese language skills alongside professional-level English.Formal education in marketing, communications, journalism, or a related discipline.Travel International travel, including travel to customer and mine sites may be required. What success looks like You will bring together marketing judgment, storytelling, and practical content creation skills to produce work that serves a clear purpose. You will be comfortable moving between strategy and execution: discussing a business priority with stakeholders one day, interviewing a customer or filming on location the next, and then shaping that material into content for multiple channels. Most importantly, you will understand that effective content starts with the audience and the problem we are trying to solve — not the format we want to produce. About Hexagon Hexagon is the global leader in measurement technologies. We provide the confidence that vital industries rely on to build, navigate, and innovate. From microns to Mars, our solutions ensure productivity, quality, safety, and sustainability in everything from manufacturing and construction to mining and autonomous systems. Hexagon's Mining division connects the physical and digital worlds of a mine, helping customers make better-informed decisions across the mining lifecycle. Our technologies support safer operations, improved productivity, and better use of resources from mine planning and operations through to processing.

Ability to clearly communicate verbally, read, write, see and hear to perform essential functions. Proficiency in reading, comprehending, and generating technical manuals, as well as related telephony documentation. Demonstrated ability to model empathy, compassion, and emotional intelligence. Experience in a values-driven organization with a strong commitment to inclusion and belonging. Ability to cultivate a psychologically safe environment where all team members can thrive. Our work emphasizes autonomy, flexibility and distributed decision-making to leverage the strengths of individuals. Everything we do is to advance ASU’s charter -- measuring who we include and how they succeed. We are staunch champions of learner success and put people first. Flexibility. Our flexible work environment allows employees to explore opportunities with their supervisor beyond the traditional work schedule. Opportunities include hybrid work where staff are in person three days per week. Culture forward. We embrace a Positive Core culture: Belonging, Relational, Authentic, Visionary and Empowered. Scale of impact. Our work changes the world. With 200k+ learners, faculty, researchers and staff, working with ET means you have the capacity to improve many lives and entire communities. World-class, low cost education. Our professional development is built in! ET encourages staff to seek additional certificates and degrees via ASU’s top ranked programs with major tuition breaks. Bring finished assets to market with the paid channel teams, and feed performance results into the next round of concepts. ERP analysts in th…

Full description

As Strategic Partnerships Manager: Analyst and Agency Partners, you own Intuit's commercial relationships with two distinct partner segments that sit at the edges of the mid-market ERP ecosystem: independent ERP analysts, and digital marketing agencies whose client base includes mid-market businesses evaluating ERP solutions. ERP analysts in the mid-market are not the large research firms — they are independent voices: channel consultants, software selection advisors, and influential commentators who cover mid-market ERP platforms, shape buyer decisions, and maintain active networks of prospects and VARs. They generate a steady flow of referral introductions to buyers who trust their judgment. Building relationships with the right analysts and turning those relationships into a consistent pipeline of qualified warm introductions is the core of this motion. Digital marketing agencies represent a different but equally valuable opportunity. Many agencies serve mid-market clients who need ERP solutions as part of broader digital transformation work — and those agencies need somewhere to route those leads. This role builds the program and relationships that make Intuit the natural destination for those introductions. Both motions share the same KPI: qualified warm introductions attributable to a specific analyst or agency partner. You are not accountable for closed-won revenue — you are accountable for the quality and volume of the pipeline you generate through these relationships. PRIMARY KPI: Qualified warm introductions attributable to a specific analyst or agency partner — defined as a mid-market prospect introduction where an IES, QuickBooks Advanced, or Intuit Services opportunity has been identified. Measured separately for analyst and agency segments. Responsibilities ERP analyst relationships Identify and map the independent ERP analyst community relevant to Intuit's mid-market segment: channel consultants, software selection advisors, VAR-channel commentators, and influential voices whose audiences include mid-market ERP buyers and channel partners.Build and maintain active relationships with target analysts, positioning Intuit Enterprise Suite and QuickBooks Advanced as platforms worth recommending — keeping analysts current on product direction, competitive positioning, and the partner program.Drive a consistent cadence of introductions from analyst relationships: warm referrals from analysts to mid-market prospects actively evaluating or replacing ERP platforms.Provide analysts with the product knowledge, competitive context, and reference materials they need to credibly recommend Intuit's mid-market platform to their audiences and clients.Track analyst-sourced introductions through the attribution model, ensuring each qualified referral is tagged to the originating analyst and reflected in pipeline reporting. Digital marketing agency relationships Identify and recruit digital marketing agencies whose client base includes mid-market businesses with ERP needs — prioritizing agencies with active practices in verticals where IES has strong product-market fit.Build the agency partner engagement model: define the value proposition for agency partners, develop the referral process and attribution mechanism, and create the co-marketing and lead-routing infrastructure that makes it easy for agencies to send leads to Intuit.Enable agency partners on Intuit's mid-market product lineup and lead qualification criteria — ensuring that introductions from agencies meet the quality threshold for IES sales engagement.Drive ongoing engagement with active agency partners: regular pipeline reviews, co-marketing activity, and program performance conversations.Track agency-sourced introductions through the same attribution model as the analyst segment. Portfolio management & reporting Maintain an active and prioritized portfolio of analyst and agency partners, with clear visibility into relationship health, referral activity, and pipeline contribution per partner.Identify underperforming relationships and develop targeted activation plans — additional enablement, co-marketing investment, or relationship reset as appropriate.Report regularly on analyst and agency pipeline contribution to Felicia Wilson and the broader Commercial Partnerships leadership.Surface market intelligence from analyst and agency conversations — buyer sentiment, competitive dynamics, and segment trends — to the IES product and go-to-market teams. Cross-functional collaboration Collaborate with the ISV Partner Manager and other Commercial BD colleagues to identify where analyst or agency relationships intersect with or amplify other partner motions.Work with marketing to develop analyst-specific content programs, agency co-marketing campaigns, and thought leadership materials that strengthen Intuit's position in the mid-market ERP ecosystem.Engage with the IES product team to keep analyst partners current on roadmap direction and ensure that Intuit's product story is compelling and accurate in analyst-generated content and recommendations. Qualifications Required 10+ years of experience in channel partnerships, business development, or partner management within a SaaS or enterprise software company.Familiarity with the mid-market ERP analyst and channel consultant community — you know who the influential voices are, how they operate, and what motivates them to refer business.Demonstrated experience building commercial partner relationships and driving referral pipeline through those relationships.Strong communication and relationship-building skills: able to engage credibly with independent analysts and digital agency principals, and to maintain productive long-term relationships with minimal formal program infrastructure.Experience managing a partner portfolio with clear pipeline tracking and attribution discipline.Proficiency with CRM tools (Salesforce preferred) and standard sales and partnership productivity platforms. Preferred Direct experience working with mid-market ERP channel analysts, software selection consultants, or VAR-channel commentators — you have existing relationships in this community.Experience building agency partner programs, including referral process design, lead qualification frameworks, and co-marketing infrastructure.Familiarity with Intuit Enterprise Suite, QuickBooks Advanced, or competing mid-market ERP platforms (Sage Intacct, Acumatica, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics). Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender. The expected base pay range for this position is: Albany $189,500 - $256,000 California Remote (Bay Area) $186,500- $252,500 Mountain View, CA $186,500- $252,500

Unió Digital has grown almost entirely on word of mouth. This role is how we widen that. The Marketing & Business Development Coordinator owns top-of-funnel engagement: the vendor-funded programs, the hosted events, the social presence, and the content that puts us in front of Arizona businesses before they have a problem to solve. This is a new role, both for Unió Digital and for the Sales & Marketing team. We are a small company in a growth phase, so expect to wear several hats and expect the shape of the job to move as we learn what works. Whoever takes this seat helps define what it becomes rather than inheriting a finished playbook. In a given month you might build a co-marketing campaign against a vendor's marketing development fund budget, host a lunch-and-learn for a dozen operations managers, run a webinar with one of our security partners, publish a blog post and tune the page it lives on, and keep LinkedIn moving in between. You will be out of the office and in front of people regularly, including some evenings. We do not hard sell. Clients call us back because we find the thing that is actually broken and fix it. Every conversation you start should follow that pattern: understand the problem first, then talk about whether we are the right answer. As a campus with residential housing facilities, the Main Campus ASR also includes a combined Annual Fire Safety report with information on fire statistics and fire safety systems, policies, and procedures. Paper copies of the Reports can be obtained by contacting the University Compliance Office at cleryact@arizona.edu.

Help strengthen partner satisfaction and retention through consistent communication and responsive support. Partnership Deliverables & Fulfillment Coordinate and track contracted partnership benefits and deliverables to help ensure accurate, timely fulfillment. Maintain deliverable timelines, status updates, and supporting documentation. Coordinate with internal teams, including marketing, sales, creative, and communications, to facilitate partner benefits and confirm expectations. Serve as a liaison between assigned partners and internal teams regarding deliverable details, deadlines, and required materials. Assist with preparing partner updates and supporting materials that communicate the value and results of Visit Mesa partnership benefits. Identify potential fulfillment gaps or delays and communicate them promptly to the Director, Destination Experience. Content Capture & Social Media Support Capture photo and video content during partner visits, events, and destination experiences for use across Visit Mesa marketing channels. Assist with the development of partner-focused content that highlights Mesa businesses, experiences, events, and destination offerings. Support social media execution by drafting and scheduling posts, monitoring comments and messages, and engaging with audiences in alignment with Visit Mesa’s voice and established guidelines. Coordinate with the Content Marketing Manager to ensure partner-related content aligns with the content calendar, campaign priorities, and brand standards. Organize and maintain content assets, permissions, and relevant partner information for efficient future use. Stay current on social media trends, emerging platforms, and community engagement opportunities, sharing relevant ideas with the marketing team. Community Outreach & Cross-Functional Support Represent Visit Mesa professionally at partner meetings, partnership events, community events, and relevant industry functions. Support partnership events, outreach activities, and initiatives that promote partner engagement and revenue growth. Assist with special projects and other department needs as assigned. Help maintain the visitor center and answer incoming phone calls as needed. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, Tourism, Business, or a related field preferred; equivalent education and experience may be considered. Minimum of 3–5 years of experience in content marketing, digital communications, or a related field. Hospitality, tourism, association, or economic development experience preferred. Excellent writing, editing, and communication skills with the ability to adapt content for diverse audiences. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities independently while collaborating effectively in a team environment. Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Outlook, Excel, Teams, SharePoint, and PowerPoint) required; experience with Adobe Creative Suite and email marketing platforms preferred. Ability to quickly learn industry-specific platforms and emerging marketing technologies. Core Competencies Content strategy, storytelling, and exceptional writing and editing skills with the ability to create engaging, audience-focused content while maintaining Visit Mesa's brand voice and standards. Project and campaign management, including the ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and stakeholders simultaneously. Data-informed decision-making using performance metrics, audience insights, and analytics to optimize content and campaigns. Collaboration and relationship building across departments, agency partners, vendors, and community stakeholders. Creativity, innovation, and adaptability with a commitment to continuous learning and staying current on emerging marketing trends and technologies. Ability to leverage emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence (AI), to enhance content development, audience engagement, marketing effectiveness, and operational efficiency. Commitment to Visit Mesa's mission, values, and destination marketing objectives. Position Details Full-time, non-exempt position Hybrid (office located in Downtown Mesa) Full health benefits and 401(k) opportunity Salary: $60,000 - $65,000 (DOE) Schedule: Monday – Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM, with minimal evening and weekend hours required Expectations The Partnership & Social Media Specialist is expected to adhere to all Visit Mesa rules of employment as described in the employee manual. Employee may perform other related duties as assigned and not included in this job description to meet the ongoing needs of the organization. All questions about this job description should be directed to Audry Brinkman, Director, People and Operations, at audry@visitmesa.com, or at 480-682-3789.
